policy: The rules propose a test or refer to a recorded test, never infer final metal recovery, select equipment models, or approve a process.

rules.description: Observed coarse liberated Au motivates size-resolved GRG and product-accounted gravity tests; GRG is not plant recovery.

rules.description: Source-backed observation of Au locked in sulphides and a poor direct leach result motivates flotation and comparison of pre-oxidation methods; POX/BIOX is not approved by S/As alone.

BIOX series plus subsequent CIL, separately timed and balanced

rules.description: A direct leach baseline and its residue should be recorded for every studied ore type; it does not predict recovery or imply CIP must be tested.

excluded_from_public_rules.reason: No positive measured preg-robbing case in A–D; total organic carbon and an uncalibrated index are not a valid gate.
Arbitrary percentage cutoffs do not establish sulfide speciation or gold entrapment; S/As remain contextual data for requesting mineralogy.
